title: Cut repeated test runs: build_release subset, Chief re-verification
reviewSummary:
Two changes that cut repeated test runs in agent sessions, plus faster checks.

1. build_release takes `tests`. Only the named scripts run against the package, and `[]` runs none. The build, packaging and start-up check still happen. The result is a PARTIAL check: `partial: {ran, skipped}` is in the result and in build.json, the note starts "PARTIAL CHECK", the build is never `ok` and can't be published. The Release section shows it as "partial check: N of M test scripts" and asks for a Rebuild. Builds started from the section still run everything. A script name that doesn't exist is refused before anything is built.
2. Faster full checks. Release test scripts run 4 at a time (Windows stays at 1), the longest last time first. Each web run gets its own in-memory storage. On the party game the web check went from 891 s to 229 s, with the same 3 failures. The studio's review checks also run 4 at a time now: they build once, keep a copy of the game in build/checks/<worktree>/game and run scripts against it directly. Measured on the party game: 9.0 min down to about 2.6 min.
3. Prompts. The delegation skill (Briefs, Checking), Chief Director, Gameplay Engineer, Conflict Resolver, merge-conflicts and odin-build now say: report the test run you did; don't re-run a suite that was reported passing at the current commit; never test a copy of the tree in /tmp; conflict resolvers run the suite once.

Tests: typecheck clean, npm test 225 passed. The engine-backed tests (runner + release: Linux, web and Windows under Wine, partial checks) pass with GAME_STUDIO_TEST_ENGINE=~/Projects/headless-game-engine. npm run e2e passed; its "read ECONNRESET" banner shows from the shader step on, before anything this change touches.
reviewLookAt: src/session-host/studio-tools.ts: build_release's new description and `tests` parameter
Release section: a build made by an agent with `tests` shows as a partial check (~ mark) and Publish is disabled
